verdict.rationale: Zep's docs explicitly describe a single-call, scope='auto' context retrieval that dynamically composes edges, nodes, episodes, observations, and thread summaries into 'a single ready-to-use block,' retrievable either via a dedicated context call or embedded directly in thread.add_messages() response, with sub-200ms performance regardless of graph size. This directly matches the token-budgeted, prompt-ready, one-call context assembly story. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a configurable token-budget parameter and independent (non-vendor) benchmarking of the latency/quality claims.
